<div class="callout-note" role="note">
<p><strong>The Roadmap was decommissioned in June 2026.</strong></p>
<p>Work to modernise government digital services continues through the <a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/digitising-government-programme-dgp/digital-target-state">Digital Government Target State</a>.</p>
</div>
<h2>Improving government digital services</h2>
<p>The Roadmap aligned effort across government agencies and drove performance as the government moved towards a more unified customer service experience for digital services.</p>
<p>Agencies were responsible for implementing their own initiatives on the Roadmap. The Digital Executive Board oversaw implementation of the Roadmap and led an annual process to refresh it in line with current government priorities. The Digital Executive Board also received regular implementation progress reports.</p>
<p>View the Roadmap as a <abbr>PDF</abbr> file, or continue browsing this page to view all initiatives.</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/assets/Digital-government/Strategy-and-insights/Service-Modernisation-Roadmap-Aug-2024.pdf">Service Modernisation Roadmap V1 (<abbr>PDF</abbr> 300<abbr>KB</abbr>)</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/insights-and-commentary/delivering-a-unified-customer-service-experience-for-digital-government-services">Read the <abbr>GCDO</abbr>’s commentary on the direction for government digital services</a></li>
</ul>
<h2>Initiatives by layer</h2>
<p>The 4 layers of the Roadmap were:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/strategy-summary/decommissioned-service-modernisation-roadmap/service-modernisation-roadmap#table-1">Customer service experience</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/strategy-summary/decommissioned-service-modernisation-roadmap/service-modernisation-roadmap#table-2">Reusable digital components</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/strategy-summary/decommissioned-service-modernisation-roadmap/service-modernisation-roadmap#table-3">Data, digital and security foundations</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/strategy-summary/decommissioned-service-modernisation-roadmap/service-modernisation-roadmap#table-4">Doing digital well</a></li>
</ul>
<p>The full name of each lead agency is provided in the glossary.</p>
<p><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/strategy-summary/decommissioned-service-modernisation-roadmap/service-modernisation-roadmap#glossary">Glossary of abbreviations for the roadmap leads</a></p>
